note: Hand-curated directory of NGOs active in the Sumatra/Borneo orangutan landscape. Not scraped, not automated — maintained manually. If a listing is outdated or a link is broken, please use the feedback email in the site footer.

organizations.name: Aidenvironment
organizations.description: International NGO working on sustainable commodity supply chains and corporate accountability for deforestation linked to palm oil and other drivers of orangutan habitat loss.

organizations.name: Borneo Futures
organizations.description: Research and policy initiative producing scenario-modelling and conservation-planning analysis for orangutans and their habitat; also contributed input to this site's design.

organizations.name: Borneo Nature Foundation
organizations.description: Research and conservation organization studying and protecting Bornean peat-swamp forest, notably the Sabangau Forest, home to one of the largest wild orangutan populations.

organizations.name: Borneo Orangutan Survival Foundation
organizations.description: Indonesia's largest primate conservation NGO, running orangutan rescue and rehabilitation centres in Central and East Kalimantan and release sites across Borneo.

organizations.name: CAN Borneo
organizations.description: Borneo-based network working on forest and land-rights issues connected to orangutan habitat protection.

organizations.name: Centre for Orangutan Protection
organizations.description: Indonesian NGO focused on direct rescue response, anti-wildlife-crime investigation, and public campaigning against orangutan trafficking and habitat destruction in Borneo.

organizations.name: Cikananga Wildlife Center
organizations.description: Wildlife rescue and rehabilitation center in West Java handling confiscated and injured wildlife, including orangutans recovered from the illegal trade.

organizations.name: Conservation International Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesia programme of the global organization Conservation International, supporting landscape conservation and policy work in Sumatra.

organizations.name: Fauna & Flora International Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesia programme of the global conservation organization Fauna & Flora International, supporting species and habitat conservation across Sumatra and Kalimantan.

organizations.name: Forum Konservasi Leuser
organizations.description: Ranger-patrol NGO running large-scale anti-poaching and snare-removal operations across the Leuser Ecosystem, directly protecting Sumatran orangutan habitat.

organizations.name: Forum Orangutan Indonesia
organizations.description: National Indonesian forum coordinating government agencies, NGOs, and researchers on orangutan conservation policy and strategy across all three species.

organizations.name: Frankfurt Zoological Society
organizations.description: Global conservation organization supporting landscape protection and anti-poaching work in Sumatra, including areas within the orangutan range.

organizations.name: Friends of the National Parks Foundation
organizations.description: Indonesian NGO running reforestation and community-conservation programmes around national parks, including orangutan release sites such as the Lamandau Wildlife Reserve.

organizations.name: Gunung Palung Orangutan Conservation Program
organizations.description: Research and community-conservation programme centered on Gunung Palung National Park, West Kalimantan, one of the best-studied wild orangutan populations in Borneo.

organizations.name: HUTAN – Kinabatangan Orangutan Conservation Programme
organizations.description: Long-running field research and community-based conservation programme in the Lower Kinabatangan floodplain, Sabah — one of the longest-studied wild orangutan populations in Borneo.

organizations.name: Health in Harmony
organizations.description: NGO linking affordable community healthcare access to rainforest protection around Gunung Palung National Park, West Kalimantan, reducing pressure on orangutan habitat from illegal logging.

organizations.name: INDECON
organizations.description: Aceh/Leuser-focused environmental communication and advocacy organization.

organizations.name: Institute Green Aceh
organizations.description: Aceh-based forest-monitoring and environmental-advocacy NGO working on Leuser Ecosystem issues.

organizations.name: Integrated Conservation
organizations.description: NGO working on community-based conservation and human-wildlife coexistence programmes in Central Kalimantan.

organizations.name: International Animal Rescue Indonesia
organizations.description: Runs a rescue, rehabilitation, and release centre in Ketapang, West Kalimantan, for orangutans displaced by deforestation and the pet trade.

organizations.name: Jakarta Animal Aid Network
organizations.description: Indonesian animal-welfare NGO running rescue and sanctuary operations — including the Sumatra Wildlife Centre and Ellis Park Sanctuary — for wildlife confiscated from the illegal trade, including orangutans.

organizations.name: Lembaga Suar Galang Keadilan
organizations.description: Sumatra-based environmental-justice and legal-advocacy organization.

organizations.name: Link-AR Borneo
organizations.description: West Kalimantan NGO working on forest governance and community land-rights issues connected to orangutan habitat.

organizations.name: Masarang Foundation
organizations.description: Dutch-Indonesian foundation working on sustainable agroforestry (sugar palm) and reforestation in North Sulawesi and Kalimantan; historically linked to orangutan rehabilitation work through its founder's involvement with BOS.

organizations.name: Nature For Change
organizations.description: Sumatra-focused conservation and habitat-protection organization.

organizations.name: Orang Utan Republik Foundation
organizations.description: US-based NGO supporting Sumatran orangutan conservation through conservation scholarships, education, and field-project funding. (A distinct organization from "The Orangutan Project", also listed in this directory, despite the similar name.)

organizations.name: Orangutan Appeal UK
organizations.description: UK charity supporting the Sepilok Orangutan Rehabilitation Centre and the Sabah Wildlife Department's orangutan rescue and release work in Sabah, Malaysian Borneo.

organizations.name: Orangutan Foundation (UK)
organizations.description: UK-registered charity supporting habitat protection, ranger patrols, and reforestation around Tanjung Puting and the Lamandau Wildlife Reserve, Central Kalimantan.

organizations.name: Orangutan Foundation International
organizations.description: Founded by primatologist Birute Galdikas; supports Camp Leakey and orangutan research, care, and forest protection in and around Tanjung Puting National Park, Central Kalimantan.

organizations.name: Orangutan Information Centre
organizations.description: Sumatra-based NGO (also known as YOSL-OIC) running wildlife rescue, forest restoration, and community-based forest protection across the Leuser Ecosystem and Batang Toru.

organizations.name: Orangutan Land Trust
organizations.description: Works range-wide on securing and restoring orangutan habitat, including land purchase/protection mechanisms and sustainability standards engagement with the palm oil sector.

organizations.name: PADHI Foundation
organizations.description: Sumatra-based community-conservation foundation.

organizations.name: PanEco Foundation
organizations.description: Swiss foundation that co-founded and funds the Sumatran Orangutan Conservation Programme (SOCP) alongside YEL.

organizations.name: People Resources and Conservation Foundation
organizations.description: Regional community-based natural-resource-management organization with programmes in West Kalimantan supporting forest and orangutan habitat conservation.

organizations.name: Planet Indonesia
organizations.description: Community-based conservation organization in West Kalimantan running co-managed protected areas and ranger patrols relevant to orangutan habitat.

organizations.name: ProFauna Indonesia
organizations.description: Longstanding Indonesian wildlife-protection NGO campaigning against the illegal wildlife trade and poaching, including orangutan trafficking.

organizations.name: Rainforest Action Network
organizations.description: US-based campaigning organization targeting corporate supply chains (palm oil, pulp and paper) linked to deforestation in Sumatra.

organizations.name: Rainforest Trust
organizations.description: US-based organization funding land protection and the creation of new protected areas, including sites within the Sumatran orangutan range.

organizations.name: SKEPHI
organizations.description: Indonesian forest-conservation network (Sekretariat Kerjasama Pelestarian Hutan Indonesia) working on forest-protection advocacy and campaigns against illegal logging and wildlife crime.

organizations.name: Save Our Borneo
organizations.description: Central Kalimantan watchdog NGO monitoring oil-palm and mining concessions and pursuing legal advocacy against deforestation affecting orangutan habitat.

organizations.name: Sintang Orangutan Center
organizations.description: Orangutan rescue and rehabilitation center in Sintang, West Kalimantan, caring for orangutans confiscated from the pet trade and displaced by deforestation.

organizations.name: Sumatra Ranger Project
organizations.description: Ranger-patrol organization conducting anti-poaching and snare-removal work in Sumatran forests.

organizations.name: Sumatra Rescue Alliance
organizations.description: Sumatra-based wildlife rescue and anti-poaching alliance.

organizations.name: Sumatran Orangutan Conservation Programme
organizations.description: Joint programme of PanEco, YEL, and the Indonesian government running orangutan rescue, rehabilitation, and reintroduction centres, plus Batang Toru conservation work for Pongo tapanuliensis.

organizations.name: Sumatran Rainforest Institute
organizations.description: Sumatra-focused rainforest research and conservation institute.

organizations.name: TFCA Sumatra / Leuser Conservation Partnership
organizations.description: Grant-making partnership (Tropical Forest Conservation Act Sumatra) funding conservation projects across the Leuser Ecosystem and other Sumatran landscapes.

organizations.name: TRAFFIC
organizations.description: Global wildlife trade monitoring network; tracks and reports on illegal orangutan trafficking and the pet trade as part of its broader wildlife crime work in Southeast Asia.

organizations.name: Tasikoki Wildlife Rescue Centre
organizations.description: Wildlife rescue center in North Sulawesi handling trafficked and confiscated wildlife, including primates seized in transit through Indonesia's wildlife-trade routes.

organizations.name: The Nature Conservancy Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesia programme of the global conservation organization The Nature Conservancy, supporting forest-landscape conservation including East Kalimantan.

organizations.name: The Orangutan Project
organizations.description: Australia-based NGO that funds and partners with ground-level rescue, rehabilitation, ranger-patrol, and habitat-protection projects across both Sumatra and Borneo.

organizations.name: Tropenbos International
organizations.description: International tropical-forest research network with an Indonesia programme supporting sustainable forest-landscape management.

organizations.name: WALHI Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesia's largest environmental NGO network, pursuing legal advocacy and campaigns against deforestation and environmental harm nationwide, including in orangutan range areas.

organizations.name: WWF Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesia programme of the World Wide Fund for Nature, working on forest and species conservation, including orangutan habitat, across the country.

organizations.name: Wetlands International Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesia programme of the global wetlands-conservation organization, working on peat-swamp forest restoration — a key lowland habitat for Bornean orangutans.

organizations.name: Wildlife Conservation Society Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesia programme of the global Wildlife Conservation Society, supporting species research, protected-area management, and anti-poaching work in both Sumatra and Kalimantan.

organizations.name: Wildlife Impact
organizations.description: Conservation program-evaluation organization that assesses the effectiveness of wildlife conservation and welfare programmes, including orangutan rescue and rehabilitation efforts; also contributed input to this site's design.

organizations.name: Wildlife Rescue Center Yogyakarta
organizations.description: Wildlife rescue and rehabilitation center in Yogyakarta, Java, handling confiscated wildlife from trade seizures, including orangutans in transit.

organizations.name: World Education Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesia programme of the global NGO World Education, working on community education and livelihoods projects that intersect with forest conservation near orangutan habitat.

organizations.name: Yayasan EKONA
organizations.description: Sumatra-based conservation foundation.

organizations.name: Yayasan Ekosistem Lestari
organizations.description: Indonesian foundation (Sustainable Ecosystems Foundation) focused on protecting the Leuser Ecosystem and Batang Toru forest — the only habitat of the Tapanuli orangutan — and partnering on the Sumatran Orangutan Conservation Programme.

organizations.name: Yayasan HAkA
organizations.description: Aceh-based NGO (Hutan, Alam dan Lingkungan Aceh) monitoring and campaigning against illegal logging and deforestation in the Leuser Ecosystem.

organizations.name: Yayasan Konservasi Satwa Liar Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesian Wildlife Conservation Foundation working on species conservation in Sumatra.

organizations.name: Yayasan Leuser International
organizations.description: Foundation supporting conservation of the Leuser Ecosystem.

organizations.name: Yayasan Orangutan Indonesia
organizations.description: Central Kalimantan NGO (Yayasan Orangutan Indonesia) running community-based forest and orangutan conservation programmes.

organizations.name: Yayasan Palapa
organizations.description: Environmental protection and nature conservation foundation (Yayasan Perlindungan Lingkungan Hidup dan Pelestarian Alam) active in Sumatra.

organizations.name: Yayasan Swara Owa
organizations.description: Indonesian NGO based in Java best known for gibbon conservation and primate-trade monitoring; also engages in wildlife-crime deterrence work relevant to the illegal orangutan trade.

organizations.name: Yayasan TITIAN
organizations.description: West Kalimantan NGO (Ketapang) working on peat-swamp forest and orangutan-habitat conservation, closely partnered with local rescue and rehabilitation efforts.

organizations.name: Yayasan Ulos Heritage Indonesia
organizations.description: Indonesian NGO focused on wildlife-trafficking investigation and intelligence-gathering to support law enforcement against the illegal wildlife trade, including orangutans.
